verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents AI Gateway, which sits in front of model providers and adds caching, rate limiting, retries and model fallback with one line of code. Workers AI separately offers a catalog of 50+ open-source models. However, the evidence never shows one unified endpoint reaching hundreds of models across providers. missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of models through one endpoint, documentation of a unified multi-provider API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
